No processed candidate frames are supplied to establish complete frame delivery. The attractive authored reference does not repair the clipped generated source.

The authored floor guide establishes the intended floor-center root, but there are no registered processed candidate frames or placement previews to compare physically with it. The source alone does not establish the runtime ground anchor.

The twelve raw panels appear to share the same brown-haired blue-shirted character, belt, trousers and boots, with similar frontal lighting. With no delivered candidate frames or candidate playback, I cannot validate consistency of the runtime animation.

The source visibly contains twelve arm-wave pose panels with two arms/legs generally readable, though some outer hands are clipped. There is no delivered frame sequence or actual candidate playback to validate twelve useful delivered dance poses forming a readable loop.

The raw panels look broadly similar in anatomy scale and the authored neutral/reference provides the nominal target, but there are no delivered candidate frames to compare against that target at runtime scale. I do not infer standing height from the source silhouette bounds or treat the authored rig as candidate evidence.

No processed candidate sequence or physical floor placements are supplied. The fixed roots shown by the authored guide describe the reference only; they cannot establish stable candidate support, absence of per-frame fitting, or absence of rescaling.

The raw generated source has conspicuous red/yellow/gray/blue fringes and smears outside arms, shoulders, torso sides and the gap between boots. These are visible background/color contamination rather than character material. No delivered processed cutouts on light/dark backgrounds are supplied to show that this has been resolved.

There are no delivered candidate frames and no candidate 12fps playback. I did not substitute a rigged-reference/control playback or infer the 12-to-1 transition from a contact sheet, so unintended pop and scale jump remain unvalidated.

Only the generated source and authored references are supplied; the registration has no candidate sprites or processing operations. There is no delivered processed artwork to compare for source-faithful extraction or undeclared geometry fitting.
